sandbachFocus: League leaders Sandbach United have a demanding week ahead with two fixtures. First, they travel to face Stockport County in the Cheshire Senior Cup on Tuesday 13 October (19:45), a cup tie against opposition from a different tier. Then they're back in league action at home to Bilston Town on Saturday 17 October (15:00), where they'll look to extend their excellent recent form—they've won four of their last five league matches and currently sit top of the table with 28 points from 12 games.
divisionWide: Several key fixtures will shape the title race this week. Second-placed Stafford Town host Brereton Social on Saturday, with Stafford coming off two consecutive draws. Third-placed Bilston Town (7 wins from 10, on a three-game winning streak) face a midweek test against Sandbach's league rivals before their weekend trip. Wolverhampton Casuals, currently fifth, host Telford Town on Saturday. AFC Bridgnorth, sixth and unbeaten in their last four league matches, host Market Drayton Town on Saturday after a midweek visit to Bridgnorth. Barnton face AFC Bridgnorth at home on Saturday, looking to maintain their strong recent form. Eccleshall host Crewe on Saturday. New Mills welcome Alsager Town (on a six-game losing streak) on Saturday. Allscott Heath host Foley Meir on Saturday in a lower-mid-table clash. Cheadle Heath Nomads travel to Shawbury United on Saturday after facing Foley Meir on Tuesday. Wednesfield Community are at home to Market Drayton Town on Saturday. Widnes Town face Crewe in a midweek fixture on Tuesday before travelling to face Dawley Town on Saturday. Crewe also play midweek at home to Widnes on Tuesday before their Saturday fixture at Eccleshall.
